sourceTitle: Easy Roasted Cauliflower Blender Soup with Smoked Paprika
sourceText:
Easy Roasted Cauliflower Blender Soup with Smoked Paprika
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, April 12, 2017 - 7:41am

Ingredients




22 ounces fresh cauliflower (washed & cut)
1 1/2 tsp sweet smoked paprika
1 tbsp bacon flavoured olive oil
4 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup greek yogurt
1/2 cup grated cheese for garnish (optional)

Preparation

1 Wash and cut cauliflower. Roast in oven at 425º F until tender. About 30 minutes. 2 Once cooked, let cool slightly. 3 Add all the ingredients (except) the cheese into a blender. 4 Press the "soup" setting. 5 Once done, pour into a bowl, garnish and enjoy.

About

Easy Roasted Cauliflower Blender Soup With Smoked Paprika is quick and delicious. With a few ingredients and a simple cheat, soup is ready in no time.
